Name: Unique Slovenia / Custom Tour Designer
Company description: UNIQUE SLOVENIA is a tour designer offering custom made tours for a traveller who think travel is more about a unique, authentic experience – with personalisation, privacy, spiritual well-being and even simplicity as the overarching goals. The company was established to share our intimate knowledge of Slovenia with those travelers looking for unique travel experiences. We pride ourselves in being able to take clients to unique destinations, while proving the highest levels of personal service. We strive to do this with elegance and sophistication, exclusivness and individuality. Our goal is to consistently exceed our client’s expectations and personally ensure that every aspect of client's time with us is perfect.  We create specialised tours (wine and gourmet tour, cooking tour, active tours…), short breaks or getaways and custom made tours that are designed according to client's desire and budget. Luxury private jets to Slovenia or any other world destination with inclusive or exclusive custom voyages can be obtained for most demanding clients.  On the US market we  partner with Virtuoso member tour operators Travcoa and Frontiers International Travel. Lately we have established partnership with Searchlights, an incentive tour operator. In Great Britain we work closely with luxury tour operator Amazing Voyages.   Our motto »You name it, we do it« is literaly what we do. Slovenia is our country and we know it backward and forward. We know the best place to stand to get that perfect photography of Bled Island, how to beat the crowds in the popular summer months, and where to go when you want to get off the beaten path. Slovenia is full of secrets, too— hidden places most people don't know about. We've traveled the country from top to bottom innumerable times, so if there's something worth seeing, we know about it. Just consider us your personal concierge—wherever you want to go, whatever you want to do, we'll make it happen.

Name: Peterc Vineyard Estate
Company description: The upscale Peterc Vineyard Estate, overlooking a 200 year-old vineyard plot, lies perched atop Brda wine country, where the Mediterranean meets the Alps. The area offers the best of both worlds in an endless array of exciting things to do, including dining at the finest gourmet restaurants or authentic local osterias, touring local award–winning wineries, indulging in outdoor activities in the region’s breathtaking scenery and exploring its amazing history. Our exclusive establishment welcomes guests age 16 and over. Easily accessible at just 30min from Trieste airport or a short 90 minutes from Venice Marco Polo, Treviso and Ljubljana airports. The Peterc Vineyard Estate offers a selection of bright and elegant accommodations situated in a peaceful and authentic setting. Our vineyard estate in the Brda hills is designed for the adult traveler seeking a tranquil, relaxing and indulgent atmosphere. With our carefully appointed rooms, luxury amenities, and beautiful views arching across the vineyards and olive groves all the way to the Adriatic Sea, you won’t find a more romantic place to stay in Brda than at the Peterc Vineyard Estate in Kojsko. At Peterc Vineyard Estate breakfast is a most important luxury, always included in the price of your stay and served till 12.00 o’clock. Choose from our delicious a la carte menu with complimentary sparkling wine. Guests can taste our exclusive selection of »Best of Brda« products from carefully sourced local suppliers, including freshly baked morning patisserie. A heavenly start to your day with a seasonal menu spoiling you with fresh, local and home-made delicacies. All our Experiences are tailor made to fit our guests’ requirements. Browse through our à la carte menu of suggestions and contact us to help you plan a unique experience customized to your interests and schedule (subject to availability and seasonality). Company description: Power is a precious commodity, especially if you’re out in the middle of nowhere. We strive to provide solutions for anyone who may find themselves without the ability to rely on the power grid for their electricity. We focus on portable devices because when everything else is gone, being able to call for help from wherever you are can be the difference between life and death. Just think of us as your solar power concierge. Our team will take care of everything from design to installation. All you have to do is watch it come together.
